scope: All 226 reviewed table rows, compared only with associated class-source typed snapshots. Detail-page values and historical differences remain a separate review.
comparison_policy: Compare exact raw strings for cost/cast/range, category for school, tooltip for effect. No unit inference or synonym normalization. table_blank means no printed observation to compare. Counts are row/status counts across parser snapshots, not entities; a row can have multiple statuses. Absence is a coverage gap, not conflicting game facts.
